expected_form.resumen: Overheated network room: rack cabinet A3 at 36 °C from a minisplit not cooling, brought down to 28 °C with forced ventilation; VPN briefly down for the remote accountants.
expected_form.que_paso: He got to the network room to a burnt smell: rack cabinet A3 was reading 36 degrees and the minisplit was only blowing warm air; it got serviced and the filters cleaned with no improvement; with an industrial fan at the door the cabinet came down to 28 degrees and held steady. The VPN was down for a while as the rack struggled and the outside accountants could not pull their reports.

timeline.evento: Arrival at the network room; burnt smell from the doorway
Rack cabinet A3 reading 36 °C; minisplit blowing warm air
Forced ventilation with an industrial fan at the room door

action_items: Fix the network room minisplit (maintenance, this same week)
Buy a spare industrial fan for the network room

user_utterances.text: Can you hear me OK?... I'm out of the accountants' office now, it was that network room that smelled overheated... log the incident report for me before the detail slips away.

Well, I got there around seven fifty and you could already smell the burning from the doorway... at eight fifteen the rack A three cabinet was reading thirty-six degrees and the minisplit was only blowing warm, I serviced it, cleaned the filters, and nothing.
That's it... then at eight forty-five I put an industrial fan at the room door... and around ten thirty I had the cabinet down to twenty-eight degrees, steady.
The one that was struggling was rack A three, the one in the network room... the A eight, the telecom one, never even flinched, still healthy.
A three, the one in the network room... I never touched A eight, I'm telling you that one is healthy.
That one... and the VPN also went down for a while, the outside accountants couldn't get in to pull their reports... that was everything that was affected.
Yes, that one... and put it down as high, if that rack had gone dark the filings for eleven clients would have stopped, better high.
High, yes... and note two follow-ups: have maintenance check the minisplit this same week, and buy a spare industrial fan for the room.
That's fine... send it now, I've got the next job on top of me.
